question: Which maidens and which early lunar timings are excluded or specified for desire-rites?
premises: For a desire-rite, a bodily impaired maiden must not be chosen.
A menstruating maiden must also not be chosen.
The verse specifies timings involving the first and fourth lunar days with Śravaṇa and the three Uttara stars.
inference: Desire-rites require both physical suitability of the maiden and precise lunar-asterism timing.
uncertainties: The exact ritual role of the named days and stars in this verse is compressed and may depend on the following verses.
plain_english: For a desire-rite, one must not choose a maiden who is bodily impaired or menstruating; the rite is also tied to the first lunar day with Śravaṇa and the fourth day with the three Uttara stars.
